# Wisermax HN

> Wisermax HN (Wiser Max HN Company Limited) is a garment manufacturer in Gia Lam, Hanoi, Vietnam, founded in 2014. It develops and produces fashion collections for European and US labels: OEM, ODM and private label, full package, shipped FOB Hai Phong.

## Key facts

- Type: apparel manufacturer (own factory, not a trading company)
- Location: Trau Quy Ward, Gia Lam District, Hanoi, Vietnam
- Products: jersey and fleece (tees, polos, sweatshirts, hoodies, shorts), woven fashion (shirts, blouses, dresses, trousers), knit dresses and womenswear, kidswear ages 2–14 (EN 14682, CPSIA)
- Capacity: about 600,000 pieces a month, 6,000,000+ a year
- Minimum order: 500 pieces per style, from 200 per colour
- Lead time: samples 2–3 weeks; bulk 45–60 days after sample approval
- Quality: inline checks, final inspection to AQL 1.0 / 2.5
- Shipping: FOB Hai Phong; sea freight to Rotterdam, Hamburg, Antwerp, Los Angeles, New York, Vancouver
- Contact: ship@wiser.vn · +84 974 806 625
